title: Project the gradient derivative to the same tangent plane
source_anchor: Boumal, §5.5, Corollary 5.16 and Example 5.17, projected derivative with tangent domain and codomain; printed p. 96 / PDF p. 112
target_statement: At a unit sphere point x, restrict the derivative of the smooth ambient extension of the induced gradient to vectors perpendicular to x and orthogonally project its output onto that same tangent plane. This is the embedded-sphere realization of the Hessian operator.
